_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Kano model feature and customer-need classification for product, service, and quality decisions: classify candidate…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Use the Kano model to classify these feature requests into must-be, performance, delighter, indifferent, and reverse categories."
cases.context: The agent has access to the kano-model skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is kano-model the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes kano-model as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against prioritization, user-research, research-synthesis
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the kano-model workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore kano-model
Does not route to prioritization, user-research, research-synthesis when the kano-model scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
